en: List all available PDF specification documents. Returns document IDs, titles, page counts, and categories, plus `coverage.gaps` — the normative areas this corpus does NOT contain (PDF/A, PAdES). Read the gaps before concluding that a requirement does not exist. Use the returned IDs as the `spec` parameter in other tools. `unrecognizedFiles` names the PDFs in PDF_SPEC_DIR that no pattern recognised — they were NOT read. Every other tool returns the id of the spec it read as `spec` (the default when `spec` was omitted); compare_versions returns `specs`.
